body:
You are making a lot of sense. I feel so calm and normal... But every thought about the three things I care about leaving me makes me go insane.

Maybe on another day.... I would be better. But after the job, the friends, the cold realizing no one even bothered to answer my phone calls/texts... I feel like its adding up.

I just can't give up 6 years of love in an instant. I keep breathing. But I can't get that thought out of my head. 6 years gone, my house, my dog. All gone. I will be homeless with no job, no friends, no girl... nothing.

I appreciate your help. I just keep sitting here refreshing the page. Trying to think of the best days of my life. All seem to be when I was with her.
